 Hilary Swank is 'so blessed' as she reflects on 'geriatric' pregnancy live on air
 Yellowjackets actress Hilary Swank is expecting her third child at the age of 52
 Add to preferred sources Comments Entertainment Sara Baalla Screen Time TV Reporter 09:26 ET, 17 Nov 2026 Updated 09:44 ET, 17 Nov 2026 View 3 Images Hilary Swank is expecting her third child at the age of 52 (Image: ITV) 
 Actress Hilary Swank has candidly spoken about her "geriatric" pregnancy.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 The 52-year-old actress is expecting her third child with her husband, Philip Schneider. The couple previously welcomed twins, a son and daughter named Ohm and Aya, back in April 2023, when Hilary was 48 years old.
 The Oscar-winning star spoke about her pregnancy on Tuesday (November 17), as she appeared on UK daytime show This Morning to promote the final season of Yellowjackets. During the interview, host Cat Deeley said: "Your kids must be so excited for Christmas this year, as well? Because it's literally like, they are in the sweet spot of Santa Claus, and there's a special delivery!"
 Hilary replied: "They're so excited about this baby. They keep saying, 'When's the baby coming? When's the baby coming?' And I say, 'Christmas time.' And they wake up pretty much every morning, saying, 'Is it Christmas yet?' They're so excited."
 READ MORE : Robert Pattinson fans spot Twilight 'predicted' James Bond casting 18 years ago READ MORE : Robert Pattinson has power to 'reinvent himself' as Batman and now James Bond, PR expert says Content cannot be displayed without consent Cat then asked: "Are they super excited about the new baby?" before Hilary said: "Super excited. I mean, for now. We'll see what happens when the baby comes."
 ‌ 
 The host added: "And how do you feel? Because I remember, I had James, who's my youngest, I had him at 42. And everybody was like [widens eyes]. I think I was called a geriatric mum, which is so weird."
 View 3 Images The actress appeared on UK daytime programme This Morning (Image: ITV) 
 ‌ 
 Hilary noted: "By the way, you're geriatric, I think, at 34," before adding: "We're so advanced in our world and people are living so much longer, you know, and so many women are wanting to wait until later. It's becoming quite a normal thing to have children later.
 "For me, I feel like a singleton is much easier to carry than twins, I would say. And I was working with my twins up until the three weeks into my third trimester, so it was a lot. I was working 18-hour days and I had two body doubles because they couldn't work overtime. But the pregnant, geriatric lady could."
 ‌ 
 The star continued: "I just feel so blessed to be a working actor, a storyteller, a mom. My career really was a baby of mine that I wanted to give to, and I didn't want distractions. I wanted to give to that.

 View 3 Images Hilary is already mother to twins Ohm and Aya (Image: Raymond Hall/GC Images) 
 "And now, I have both. I feel so blessed, so grateful, and I love it more than anything... I wake up with such gratitude [to have] the opportunity to do it, I wake up with the gratitude that I now have life again, and I have my two children. I have a wonderful husband. I have a great family support. I just really am blessed, and I couldn't be happier."
 Hilary is set to appear in the upcoming final season of Yellowjackets, which will premiere on November 20. The actress plays the adult version of Melissa, who notably faked her death after surviving the 1996 wildernesss plane crash.
 The final season of Yellowjackets will premiere on Paramount+ on Friday, November 20
